project1_part1

load data

```{r}
library(data.table)
customers <- fread("data_part1/customers.csv")
products <- fread("data_part1/products.csv")
transactions <- fread("data_part1/transactions -- January 2020.csv")
views <- fread("data_part1/views -- January 2020.csv")

transactions[, time := as.POSIXct(time, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ", tz = "UTC")]
views[, time := as.POSIXct(time, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ", tz = "UTC")]
```

Question1

```{r}
views_first_7 <- views[
  time >= as.POSIXct("2020-01-01", tz = "UTC") &
    time < as.POSIXct("2020-01-08", tz = "UTC")
]

product_views <- views_first_7[
  ,
  .(num_views = .N),
  by = product_id
]

q1_answer <- product_views[order(-num_views)][1]

q1_answer
```

Question2

```{r}
coat_products <- products[
  category == "coat",
  .(product_id)
]

coat_views <- views[
  product_id %in% coat_products$product_id,
  .(num_views = .N),
  by = product_id
]

q2_answer <- coat_views[num_views == max(num_views)]

q2_answer
```

Question3

```{r}
shoes_products <- products[
  category == "shoes",
  product_id
]

shoes_revenue <- transactions[
  product_id %in% shoes_products,
  sum(price * quantity)
]

q3_answer <- shoes_revenue

round(shoes_revenue, 2)
```

Question4

```{r}
customer_spending <- transactions[
  ,
  .(total_spending = sum(price * quantity)),
  by = customer_id
]

avg_spending <- customer_spending[
  ,
  mean(total_spending)
]

q4_answer <- avg_spending

round(avg_spending, 2)
```

Question5

```{r}
transaction_with_revenue <- transactions[, revenue := price * quantity]

transactions_with_gender <- merge(
  x = transaction_with_revenue,
  y = customers[, .(customer_id, gender)],
  by = "customer_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

total_revenue <- transactions_with_gender[
  ,
  sum(revenue)
]

female_revenue <- transactions_with_gender[
  gender == "F",
  sum(revenue)
]

female_percent <- female_revenue / total_revenue * 100

q5_answer <- female_percent

round(q5_answer, 1)
```

Question6

```{r}
customer_spending <- transactions[
  ,
  .(monthly_spending = sum(price * quantity)),
  by = customer_id
]

customer_model_data <- merge(
  x = customers,
  y = customer_spending,
  by = "customer_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

customer_model_data[is.na(monthly_spending), monthly_spending := 0]

q6_model <- lm(
  monthly_spending ~ income + age + gender + region,
  data = customer_model_data
)

summary(q6_model)

answer_q6 <- coef(q6_model)["income"] * 10000

round(answer_q6, 2)
```

Question7

```{r}
viewed_customers <- unique(views$customer_id)
purchased_customers <- unique(transactions$customer_id)

viewed_and_purchased <- intersect(viewed_customers, purchased_customers)
q7_answer <- length(viewed_and_purchased) / length(viewed_customers) * 100

round(q7_answer, 1)
```

Question8

```{r}
customer_views <- merge(
  x = views,
  y = customers[, .(customer_id, age)],
  by = "customer_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

customer_views_q8 <- customer_views[
  age >= 35 & age < 50
]

unique_products_per_customer <- customer_views_q8[
  ,
  .(num_unique_products = uniqueN(product_id)),
  by = customer_id
]

q8_answer <- median(unique_products_per_customer$num_unique_products)

q8_answer
```

Question9

```{r}
customer_views <- views[
  ,
  .(total_views = .N),
  by = customer_id
]

customer_spending <- transactions[
  ,
  .(monthly_spending = sum(price * quantity)),
  by = customer_id
]

q9_data <- merge(
  x = customers,
  y = customer_views,
  by = "customer_id"
)

q9_data <- merge(
  x = q9_data,
  y = customer_spending,
  by = "customer_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

q9_data[is.na(monthly_spending), monthly_spending := 0]

q9_model <- lm(
  monthly_spending ~ total_views + age + gender + income + region,
  data = q9_data
)

summary(q9_model)

q9_answer <- coef(q9_model)["total_views"] * 10

round(q9_answer, 2)
```
